<p><b>Metadata tier.</b> This page was rendered from one archive-metadata read taken before the server started (snapshots + index + tree + the activity sidecar). <p><b>This server is on 127.0.0.1, which is not a security boundary</b> — any other program on this machine can connect to it. Access is gated only by the random token in this page's URL. Do not share the URL. The server exits by itself when idle.</p>
